\documentclass{article}

\usepackage{dirtreex}
\pagestyle{empty}
\makeatletter
\providecommand\NSNodeName{C}
\providecommand\NSPrivateName{dte@content}
\newcount\NSHooks
\newcount\NSTreePictures
\newcount\NSFormatted
\newcount\NSPassed
\newbox\NSProbe
\newif\ifNSChecking
\newwrite\NSEvents
\newwrite\NSNodes
\immediate\openout\NSEvents=\jobname.events
\immediate\openout\NSNodes=\jobname.nodes
\let\NSFormat\DirtreexFormatName
\renewcommand\DirtreexFormatName[1]{%
  \global\advance\NSFormatted by1
  \protected@write\NSNodes{}{ENTRY \NScase:#1}%
  \NSFormat{#1}}
\tikzset{every picture/.append style={execute at end picture={%
  \ifNSChecking\else
    \global\advance\NSHooks by1
    \ifdte@inenv
      \edef\NSactualpic{\csname pgf@sh@pi@\NSprefix\NSPrivateName\NSsuffix\endcsname}%
      \edef\NSexpectedpic{\pgfpictureid}%
      \ifx\NSactualpic\NSexpectedpic\else
        \PackageError{namespace-test}{Private node affix or picture identity changed \NScase}{The private node must retain inherited affixes in this picture.}%
      \fi
      \global\advance\NSTreePictures by1
    \fi
    \path (current bounding box.south west) ++(0,-2pt);
    \protected@write\NSEvents{}{END \NScase}%
  \fi}}}
\def\NSCheckMetadata{%
  \@for\NSfield:=ns,np,nt,pi,ma\do{%
    \expandafter\let\expandafter\NSactual\csname pgf@sh@\NSfield @\NSfull\endcsname
    \expandafter\let\expandafter\NSsaved\csname pgf@sh@\NSfield @\NSguard\endcsname
    \ifx\NSactual\relax
      \PackageError{namespace-test}{Missing user node metadata \NScase}{The test must have a real user node.}%
    \fi
    \ifx\NSactual\NSsaved\else
      \PackageError{namespace-test}{User node metadata changed \NScase/\NSfield}{A dirtreex picture overwrote user node state.}%
    \fi}}
\def\NSStart#1#2#3{%
  \def\NScase{#1}\def\NSprefix{#2}\def\NSsuffix{#3}%
  \tikzset{name prefix={#2},name suffix={#3}}%
  \edef\NSfull{#2\NSNodeName#3}%
  \edef\NSguard{#2NSGuard#3}%
  \global\NSHooks=0 \global\NSTreePictures=0
  \global\NSFormatted=0
  \begin{tikzpicture}[remember picture]
    \node[draw,rounded corners=2pt] (\NSNodeName) {#1USER};
    \pgfnodealias{\NSguard}{\NSfull}%
  \end{tikzpicture}\par
  \NSCheckMetadata}
\def\NSFinish#1#2{%
  \NSCheckMetadata
  % Exercise later TikZ references under the inherited prefix/suffix.
  % The probe box is not emitted, so it adds no paragraph or page material.
  \setbox\NSProbe=\hbox{%
    \NSCheckingtrue
    \begin{tikzpicture}[remember picture,overlay]
      \foreach\NSanchor in {center,north,south,east,west}{%
        \path (\NSNodeName.\NSanchor);
        \pgfgetlastxy{\NSax}{\NSay}%
        \path (NSGuard.\NSanchor);
        \pgfgetlastxy{\NSbx}{\NSby}%
        \ifdim\NSax=\NSbx\else
          \PackageError{namespace-test}{Anchor x changed \NScase}{Later references must resolve to the user node.}%
        \fi
        \ifdim\NSay=\NSby\else
          \PackageError{namespace-test}{Anchor y changed \NScase}{Later references must resolve to the user node.}%
        \fi
      }
    \end{tikzpicture}}%
  \ifnum\NSFormatted=#1\relax\else
    \PackageError{namespace-test}{Entry formatting count changed \NScase}{Each entry must be formatted exactly once.}%
  \fi
  \ifnum\NSHooks>0\else
    \PackageError{namespace-test}{Picture hooks did not run \NScase}{The inherited picture hook must remain effective.}%
  \fi
  \ifnum\NSTreePictures<#2\relax
    \PackageError{namespace-test}{Missing tree pictures \NScase}{Whole and split painter paths must execute.}%
  \fi
  \typeout{NS-OK-\NScase}%
  \typeout{NS-TREE-PICTURES-\NScase=\the\NSTreePictures}%
  \typeout{NS-HOOKS-\NScase=\the\NSHooks}%
  \global\advance\NSPassed by1}
\AtEndDocument{%
  \ifnum\NSPassed=4
    \typeout{NS-ALL-CHECKS-PASSED}%
  \else
    \PackageError{namespace-test}{Missing namespace scenarios}{All four scenarios must execute.}%
  \fi}
\makeatother
